definitions.gloss: gift; present; gift item for formal occasions
definitions.explanation: A gift exchanged on formal or ceremonial occasions, such as seasonal greetings, weddings, or funerals. More formal than a casual present.

examples.japanese: {贈答品|ぞうとうひん}を{選|えら}ぶ。
この{店|みせ}は{贈答品|ぞうとうひん}{用|よう}の{包装|ほうそう}もしてくれる。
examples.english: This store also does gift wrapping.

examples.japanese: お{中元|ちゅうげん}やお{歳暮|せいぼ}などの{贈答品|ぞうとうひん}には{熨斗|のし}を{付|つ}けるのが{一般的|いっぱんてき}だ。
examples.english: It's customary to attach a noshi decoration to seasonal gifts like mid-year and year-end presents.

notes:
Composed of {贈答|ぞうとう} (gift-giving/exchange of gifts) + {品|ひん} (item). Refers specifically to gifts exchanged on formal occasions, as opposed to casual birthday presents or souvenirs.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {贈答品|ぞうとうひん}を{贈|おく}る: to send a gift
- {贈答品|ぞうとうひん}{売|う}り{場|ば}: gift section (in a department store)
- {贈答品|ぞうとうひん}{用|よう}: for gift-giving purposes
- {贈答品|ぞうとうひん}の{包装|ほうそう}: gift wrapping

SIMILAR WORDS:
- プレゼント: present — casual, often for birthdays or personal occasions
- {贈|おく}り{物|もの}: gift — general term covering both formal and informal gifts
- お{土産|みやげ}: souvenir — specifically a gift brought back from travel
- {引|ひ}き{出物|でもの}: wedding favor — gifts given to guests at a wedding

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japan has a strong culture of formal gift-giving. The two main {贈答品|ぞうとうひん} seasons are お{中元|ちゅうげん} (mid-year, around July) and お{歳暮|せいぼ} (year-end, around December), when people send gifts to business contacts, teachers, doctors, and others they are indebted to. Department stores set up special {贈答品|ぞうとうひん} sections during these seasons.
